A quiet week for FOCIL is still a week for FOCIL.

### Spec Updates

* The FOCIL execution spec has been merged on a [eips/amsterdam/eip-7805](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/tree/eips/amsterdam/eip-7805) branch on top of Amsterdam. Iteration will continue from there.

### Development Updates

* **[Pelle](https://x.com/PelleKrab)** has been working on rebasing the Reth FOCIL prototype on top of Amsterdam.

### EthCC

* **[Jihoon](https://x.com/jih2nn)** gave a [talk](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1trSdmKR9co) at EthCC on how FOCIL came about, how FOCIL could interact with Frame transactions and how blob FOCIL could be supported in the future.

### Links

- [FOCIL Execution Spec](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/tree/eips/amsterdam/eip-7805)
